ODOT D6: state-route candidates identified across Franklin, Delaware and Union overlays. ODOT D5: geographic coverage in Licking County (~3.03 route mi), but no State-classified road candidate identified there in the current screen. No ODOT ROW is legally confirmed yet.

Work envelope inside the controlling owner’s actual ROW/property (cable, bore pits, access, staging, restoration) or a crossing/structure approval. County/city/district polygon alone is not a permit trigger.

Filter Authority Rules for package / utilities / timeline. Filter Ohio State Gates and Chicago Gates by feature and station. Filter Station Ledger for county, place, township, road candidate and confirming record. Stations are feet from supplied KMZ feature start—not surveyed or road logpoints.

Default to show all known/available existing utilities with source/date/confidence and conflict notes. Ohio ORC 3781.27 creates a statewide designer utility-information duty. Local checklists differ: Columbus and Union explicitly list existing utilities; Cook County asks all public/private utilities; Itasca asks crossing/parallel utilities; a silent checklist is not permission to omit them. Illinois JULIE design notice is separate from dig-ticket locate.

Only report published clocks as such. Columbus plan routing: 20 business days initial per department; 10 business days resubmittal per department. Union County complete permit target: generally 2 business days. Delaware County asks submit 4–8 weeks ahead. Cook County says apply 2–3 months ahead. ODOT utility permit, IDOT D1, most other local agencies: no utility-specific guaranteed SLA found. Vendor allowances are separate estimates.

1) Get OhROW acquisition plans at D6 state-road candidate stations and confirm exact ROW owner in writing. 2) Resolve Columbus, Delaware, Franklin, Union, Licking and township road-controller spans from official ROW plans/delegations. 3) Request utility as-builts/design tickets and build SUE plan. 4) Confirm bridge/rail/water/property rights before fixing route or price. 5) Check pavement moratoria and active capital projects by road/station.

The route is conceptual, labels (Bore/Water/HW/RR) are unverified, and OH S0/S1 has a ~31.1 m join gap. Route endpoint/tie-in, installed LF basis and exact road/ROW stationing remain open. No agency has been contacted.

AHJ = authority having jurisdiction. “Candidate” = GIS/record lead requiring ROW/title/owner confirmation. “Trigger” = confirmed work/occupancy in owner-controlled property or a separate crossing/structure requirement. “No SLA found” means no published commitment located, not zero review time.
